brief_rationale: The doctor met all responsibility-chain items with appropriate workspace queries, red-flag screening, layered disposition, medication safety, and caregiver receipt. No serious or minor responsibility-chain errors were identified. At least two high-order points were completed with meaningful trajectory impact: HO3 (responsibility-chain repair on the vague antibiotic order) and HO4 (dynamic reprioritization when photo quality and adherence barriers emerged). Closure is valid with handoff to ED and documented receipt.

citations.explanation: Doctor confirms ED arrival and reinforces key messages to tell ED staff, documenting receipt of caregiver's planned actions.
citations.quote: 对，就把这几点讲清楚：烧伤术后削痂+异体皮移植

citations.explanation: Caregiver confirms arrival at ED, triage completed, and burns/ED surgeon now evaluating - concrete destination and responsible service confirmed.
citations.quote: 我们已经到急诊分诊这边了，号也挂完了

closure_assessment.explanation: Valid closure with handoff to ED burns/trauma team. Caregiver confirmed concrete destination (ED), responsible service (burns/ED surgeon), time-sensitive escalation (already in progress), and received clear instructions on what to communicate. All blocking residual risks avoided.
closure_assessment.label: valid_closure

This was integrated into both the mid-conversation advice and the final closure.

high_order_assessment.explanation: HO4 complete: Doctor dynamically reprioritized from initial plan (re-upload photos for remote review) to urgent same-day ED evaluation when new information emerged (adherent dressing causing pain, increased yellow exudate, inability to obtain adequate photos). The trajectory shifted appropriately based on evolving clinical picture.

important_non_chain_defect_assessment.explanation: No important non-chain quality defect identified. All dimensions are at least good, closure is valid, and trajectory demonstrates high-quality care with appropriate use of workspace, clear communication, and effective adaptation to real-world barriers.
